I see! The hyphen-minus in field names is causing issues because Python's regex module doesn't allow hyphens in group names by default. The PARSE_RE allows matching them, but when the regex is compiled for matching, it fails because `(?P<field-name>...)` has an invalid character in the group name.

Looking at the error message:
```
re.error: bad character in group name 'field-name' at position 5
```

The issue is that while we can match field names with hyphens in the format string (via PARSE_RE), the resulting regex pattern uses those names as Python regex group names (`(?P<name>...)`), which don't allow hyphens.

According to R5: "The Parser class and extract_format function must allow hyphen-minus characters within field names during pattern matching and extraction."

This means we need to handle this somehow. One approach is to convert hyphens to underscores or some other valid character when creating the regex group name, while still allowing the original field name to be used in the format string.
